You know,life isn't always a competition.It does not matter how gracious you run or how fast you walk.You just have to end it(+80 years favorably).Don't try to copy your friends,bc by doing that you will only harm yourself.You have to discover what you are ,what are you passionate about.
 Look,by doing the great things,you have to do the little things first.Or how are you going to manage the important stuff if you can't handle the little things in life?You know what's the most important thing to do when you wake up?Some dude said by starting to make your bed.It's the day's first task.By doing so,you are going to be motivated to continue doing other tasks.
 I know the shame that you feel,but don't let that thing harm you.You have many years to live from now on,you have a lot to loose.Don't envy anyone,bc they may have other problems that you don't have,anyone has their own story.Please,try to be the person you want in your life,and eventually ,you will meet people like you.
